name: Manage your authorisations
heading: Manage your authorisations
bodyCopy: Businesses you are authorised to represent
Listed below are the companies that you have association with and have permission to act on behalf of.
crossTypeNote: Shared trade-partner authorisation-management page observed with IPAFFS Plant Agency C. For CHED-P, the same mechanism applies to a POAO agency and its authorised POAO businesses. No CHED-P-specific DoA journey exists in the corpus.

structure.text: Businesses you are authorised to represent

govukComponents.usage: Delegation acceptance setting and associated companies.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Controls whether delegation requests from importers/exporters are automatically accepted.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: The finding records the accessible text and current Yes state but not the underlying markup, keyboard behaviour or save interaction.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Confirm whether this should be a GOV.UK radios question or another accessible persisted setting.
